## About
Mile Auto Repair is a locally owned and operated family business in Tempe. We work on cars, trucks and fleet vehicles, and our management team is on-site daily, so if you have a question you can talk to a manager right away.
We will never recommend unnecessary repairs or services. We tell you what your vehicle needs, give you a fair quote, and get you back on the road safely. Many of our neighbors mention Juan by name for keeping them updated and walking them through the work.

## Services
- Free multi-point inspection: A look over your vehicle so you know where things stand.
- Oil change, lube and filter: Routine maintenance to keep your engine running right.
- Brakes and ABS: Brake and ABS service and repair.
- Transmission service and repair: From routine transmission service to repairs.
- Air conditioning service and repair: Air conditioning service and repair for your vehicle.
- Electrical diagnosis and repair: Tracking down electrical problems, including check engine lights and drivability issues.
- Cooling system service: Radiator and cooling system service.
- Tire sales, mounting and balancing: New tires, mounted and balanced.
- Pre-purchase vehicle evaluation: Have us look over a used car before you buy it.
- Emissions repairs: Repairs to help your vehicle meet AZ emissions standards.
- Fleet services: Maintenance schedules coordinated with your fleet manager, with detailed records on file.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on my make of car?
A: Yes. We service all makes and models.

Q: What if I can't make it before you close?
A: Use our drop box in the first garage door and we will take it from there.

Q: What if my car needs a tow?
A: Call our friends at Quik Pik Towing and let them know Mile Auto Repair sent you.
